title: Tooling: integrate exact coarse arithmetic in T74 with byte-identical assembly
body:
This integrates PR2168's exact integer arithmetic into the actual expensive coarse rejection call used by the complete T74 supplier replay. It builds a separately labelled, source-bound derived copy of PR2044; the frozen parent, original engine, selected certificate, native words, precision, prices and all original assertions stay intact. **No new kappa.**

The actual full derived verifier returns `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`. The integration comparator returns `PASS_FULL_T74_EXACT_ARITHMETIC_INTEGRATION`.

**The entire assembly certificate is byte-for-byte identical to the previously executed original.** Every assembly field matches, including native/conservative endpoints, both moment engines, adjacent-grid rejection, both sets of 47 outer inequalities, profiles, invoice/source hashes, coefficients and all other proof data.

All original controls pass: 114 admission, 12 bit, 15 controller, 8 independent owner and 6 geometry. Their outcomes match. The control artifacts' expected caller-hash change is checked against the exact old/new source hashes; the independent auditor's six relocated inputs are each checked against their actual file digest, then compared as a complete basename/digest inventory. No mathematical field is removed or normalized.

The source transformation changes exactly one call plus its import, and copies the pinned PR2168 adapter. An inverse transformation reconstructs every original caller byte; the AST assertion count is preserved. A fresh derived manifest identifies the changed source honestly. Full native witnesses are unchanged, personally replayed, source-bound reuse; no fresh cold-native claim is made.

Registered Python 3.12 source/derivation checks, source-drift and assertion-disabled controls, metadata/pins, privacy and diff checks pass. The original CRLF source snapshot is preserved with an explicit format attribute. Public artifacts exclude machine timings/hardware, private identifiers, paths and raw private logs.

Reproduce the derivation and full comparison using the README commands. This is an opt-in derived integration; it does not edit a default/frozen parent. The aggregate outer wrapper and whole repository regression are outside this exact caller change; the prior CRLF/LF and historical split-skip limitations remain disclosed.

Credit PR2168 (exact arithmetic), PR2044 / Jeremy Kothe and the retained T74, PR1297/1319/1672, native, moment-engine and precision-repair contributors. Source notices remain unchanged. Prepared under dataisfire with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
